title: Heterogeneous write batch
impact: Moonshot: Adds an explicit `WriteStatement` + `executeStatements()` surface for static heterogeneous write groups: many SQL statements, one writer-isolate request, one SQLite transaction, all-or-nothing commit, and one stream invalidation after commit. Focused `heterogeneous_write_batch.dart` shows 400 mixed insert/update statements run about 7.6x to 9.5x faster than the current interactive transaction loop across an order-flipped pair (-86.9% / -89.4%). Keeps exp 197's semantic boundary by making group commit opt-in rather than hidden behind `execute()`.
